audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Irelia level 1 (her weakest point here) and 2+ items (his takeover), and marked 4-5 and first item as Skill when the prose calls them her takeover window and 'lane tyrant'. The difficulty block also contradicts itself: diff EVEN, diffRating 8.5/10, report[14] 'Hard matchup', against a 56.53% win rate.
audit.why: At level 1 Irelia has no stun and Mourning Mist's slow plus the ghoul mark punishes any step-up. From 4-5 through first item his own ghouls are free Bladesurge reset targets, which is her best stretch. At two items Maiden plus a stocked ghoul cage and the W wall win the split.
audit.corrected: Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Yorick; difficulty brought to 5/10 to match a 56.53% win rate over 1033 games and the EVEN label already on the page.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Irelia at 3, 6 and first item; Yorick at 2+ items with full Maiden. Phase text now states why rather than repeating template filler.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites is both an auto-attack reset and a heal, and the page mentions neither — his burst tell and his sustain were both invisible. Dark Procession's cooldown was never given.
audit.why: Riot text — Q Last Rites: 'Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself' (6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, autoReset flag). W Dark Procession: 'summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement' (20/18/16/14/12s) — destructible, which matters because Irelia can break it rather than walk around. E Mourning Mist reduces armour and marks for the ghouls (12/11/10/9/8s).
audit.corrected: Don'ts now name the auto-reset wind-up as the tell and Last Rites' 4-6s heal as the reason to buy Grievous Wounds; Do's gives the cage its 12s max-rank cooldown.

edits.before: Stack passive on the wave before any trade. Identify how Yorick contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Stack passive on the wave; with no stun yet, don't step into Mourning Mist's slow and let the ghouls swarm you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dark Procession's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: his ghouls are free Bladesurge reset targets, so you stick through the swarm and shred him while his stock is low.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Dark Procession's cooldown.
edits.after: First item makes you a lane tyrant — dash off his own ghouls and force fights while Dark Procession is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yorick carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Full Maiden, a stocked ghoul cage and his wall win the split you can't duel — close the game before this window opens.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Dark Procession and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. You win the lane on tempo — the real risk is his two-item splitpush, not the early trades.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Yorick carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5/10, Yorick carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: Traps you for the ghouls. Don’t get caged. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dark Procession is a destructible wall, 12s at max rank — commit after he spends it.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Last Rites is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Last Rites heals him every 4-6s — bring Grievous Wounds early.

notes: The difficulty block was internally inconsistent: diff 'EVEN', diffRating 8.5/10, report[14] 'Hard matchup', all against a 56.53% Irelia win rate. Rated down to 5/10 and the report line brought in line with the EVEN label; tone is still the red '#ff5d6c' which no longer matches an EVEN lane — that is an enum the applier will take but I left it, flagging it here for the owner. Dark Procession's wall is DESTRUCTIBLE per Riot's text, which the page never says; worth a future edit since breaking it is often better than walking around it.
